assumptions: L219 value and maximum DCR plus individual C382–C385 capacitances come from the saved design. Capacitor ESR is assumed 12 mΩ per part; DC bias/ESL are absent.
Ideal 5 V PWM at 600 kHz and 2 ns edges drives a passive network. Duty feedforward is fixed per experiment; TPS566242 feedback, soft start, current limiting and switching losses are not modeled.
Only these local capacitor branch currents are solved. Other board loads/capacitors are represented by one declared resistor and cannot be assigned individual currents.
Ideal high-side/freewheel commutation is derived; actual input hot-loop current and input-capacitor ripple require a separate source/filter/switch model.
B/H maps require assumed lumped component paths and closed ground-return filaments. They exclude the magnetic field of the inductor winding/core and all unrelated board currents.

magnetic.time_scaling: B(t,r)=sum_j kernel_j(r)*I_j(t). I_j is the matching capacitor or load branch current from a chosen SPICE case; H=B/(4*pi*1e-7) in air after converting nT to T.

validation.norm: Trapezoidal plane integral of sum_j |B_j/I_j|², not magnetic energy.

checks.title: Finite-wire kernel matches independent symmetric-wire closed form
Doubling spatial grid resolution changes kernel norm by less than 2%

notes: This is a conditional output-loop contribution, not the electromagnetic field of the whole board.
Native trace centerlines are preserved, but current division among parallel traces/pours is not solved. Each selected path is one explicit modeling hypothesis.
Package/component bridges and every ground return are assumptions. The actual ground plane has voids/islands and distributed current; no unique return wire is known.
Input high-di/dt hot loop, inductor winding/core leakage, skin/proximity/eddy currents, displacement current, dielectric effects and radiation/retardation are excluded.
Filament approximation is least accurate close to wide conductors. Provided maps begin 1 mm above the board; no copper-surface current-density claim is made.
Changing assumed return depth from 0.1015 to 1 mm produces the displayed sensitivity; neither case is a measured return-current distribution.
Quasistatic maps show simultaneous spatial response and cannot prove MHz-edge radiation or EMC compliance.
Unprotected ideal network reaches 20.22 A, exceeding U7's 6 A rated output. Actual startup protection is not represented.
Peak exceeds L219's 15.9 A saturation reference (30% inductance decrease at 25°C). Constant inductance behavior and fields scaled from this case are outside model validity, not hardware predictions.
Duty is programmed to rise over 1.39 ms. Real TPS566242 soft start acts within its feedback controller; this comparison is only a surrogate.

Saved source DCR loss matches current squared times fixed DCR.
Exact input energy equals stored plus rejected heat.
Each constant-power trajectory rises from ambient toward its own equilibrium.

limitations: Illustrative parameter study, not measured or board-qualified temperature.
Only L219 fixed-DCR dissipation is included. Core loss, additional AC winding loss, temperature-dependent DCR, U7 switching loss and all other component heating are omitted.
The 60s thermal timeline holds the final five-cycle mean electrical loss constant. No 60s electrical/firmware or real startup simulation was performed.
Rθ25 K/W and Cθ0.5 J/K are assumptions. The other four curves are parameter cases, not confidence intervals or physical upper/lower bounds.
Datasheet DC-rise ratings reflect manufacturer test fixtures and do not establish this PCB thermal path; no thermal capacitance or transient impedance was qualified.
C382–C385, U7 and RK3566 temperatures remain unknown. Do not interpolate this single component estimate into a board temperature map.
The cold-start 20.22A artifact is outside model validity and is excluded as a thermal source.
No design or safety/compliance score is raised by this illustration.

rendering_contract.sample_policy: Use the nearest saved sample and show its actual source time; do not interpolate switching edges.
rendering_contract.clocks: Each electrical case and the 60-second held-loss thermal experiment have independent physical clocks.
rendering_contract.current_scope: Only L219 and C382–C385 have mapped individual branch currents; Load current is a virtual local test load.
rendering_contract.unknown_policy: Other component currents and temperatures remain unknown; missing values are not zero.
rendering_contract.thermal_scope: Only the L219 equivalent node may receive a temperature color. Parameter cases are assumptions, not confidence bounds.
rendering_contract.field_scope: Conditional local output-loop contributions; preserve case validity and all assumed return-path labels.
